column1: # The tests that need the template model of frontend/TEMPLATE-MODEL.md.
# Decision 0063 (item GC) governs this file. "Few" in the gate of decision
# 0062 counts the tests that fail their check and that this file does not
# mark, and the rewrite takes over the marked tests.
# tools/frontend_check.py reads this file. It reports a marked test that
# does not exist or that passes its check, and prints the marked tests
# A row is a test path under tests/, the section of TEMPLATE-MODEL.md that
# passes the test, and a short cause, separated by tabs. A line that starts

column3: A template-id with independent arguments inside its own template is read as dependent, so its member is not checked at the definition (DEP-30, DEP-15).
The same: Meter<0>::unit is read as a member of a dependent specialization (DEP-15, DEP-1).
No value-dependence mark: Slot<sizeof(N)> is read as dependent, so the call binds late (DEP-4, DEP-5).
The same: Box<sizeof(N)>::type is read as a member of a dependent specialization (DEP-4).
The current instantiation of an enclosing class is an unknown base (DEP-11).
An object of the current instantiation has an unknown type in a pattern, so the member template is not found (DEP-24, DEP-2).
The same, so a name that the class does not declare is not known to need template (DEP-24).
The same, for a member template of an independent base (DEP-24).
The same, through a reference parameter of the class's own type (DEP-24, DEP-2).
A parameter of the class's own type has an unknown type in the pattern, so a constructor that takes the class by value is not seen at the definition (CPY-15, DEP-2).
Lookup in a specialization sees declarations after its point of instantiation (INST-33, INST-30).
The same (INST-33).
The same, for a static member's initializer (INST-32, INST-31).
The same, and the initializer is made with the class (INST-33, INST-5).
A static constexpr member's initializer is made with the class and not at its first use (INST-33, INST-5, INST-8).
The same (INST-5).
An inline static member's initializer is made with the class, so its type is completed while the class argument is incomplete (INST-5, Q-0231).
The members of a local class in a specialization are made with the function and not at their use (INST-12, INST-6).
The same (INST-12, INST-6).
Function bodies made at the end of the unit have no busy state, so endless nesting is not caught (INST-15, TR-13).
A variable partial specialization with no primary does not reach the check (TSP-31).
Substitution into the operand of a conditional explicit is not done (DED-24).
A substitution mutes every error, and the lambda body is outside the immediate context (DED-29).
The same, in a template parameter's default (DED-29).
A member of the wrong kind stops the replay as unsupported (DED-24).
The pattern's parse does not check an independent call in a discarded statement (IF-22, DEP-6).
The member's trailing clause is not kept for the definition outside the class (CNS-29).
The same, with no clause on the definition (CNS-29).
No check of an operator function that only an empty pack makes valid (DEP-37).
The same (DEP-37).
The scan of an expansion pattern does not know that a fold uses up its pack (PACK-8).
The same, for sizeof... (PACK-8).
